```java
public class IsPrefix {

            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    //@ behaviors disjoint;

    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
```

public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
```java
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires mat.length > 0;
    //@ requires \forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i].length == mat[0].length;
    //@ ensures \result == true <==> (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]);
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 <= i < mat.length;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
```
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j < mat[0].length;

```java
                }
            }
```
```java
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    }
```

```java
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {

                index = index + 1;
```
            }

public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
```java
    }
}
```

        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
```java
    }
}
```

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {

```java
            }
```

```java
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {

            } else {

            }
        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}
```

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}
```

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];

```java
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
```
                return i;
        return -1;

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    }
```

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
```
```java
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
```
```java
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
```
```java
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
```
```java
        while (i < pat.length()) {

            i = i + 1;
        }
```

```java
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= pat.length() && (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j));
```

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```java
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {

            return null;

        int n = b.length;

            //@ }
```

            //@ maintaining (0 <= i && i < n) {
            //@     ret[i + m] == b[i];
            //@ }
        }

        return ret;

```java
        //@ ensures (\forall int i; a.length <= i && i < a.length + b.length; \result[i] == b[i - a.length]);
```

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
```java
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];
```

```java
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {

        int[] res = new int[n];
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```java
    //@                      (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
    //@                      (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@                      (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6)));
```

    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }

```java
    //@ maintaining 0 <= i < len / 2;
    //@ ensures (\forall int j; 0 <= j <= i; 
    //@                     ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
    //@                      (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
    //@                      (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
    //@                      (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
    //@                      (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6)));
```
    for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
        int a = digits[i];
        int b = digits[len - i - 1];

              (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
              (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
              (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
            return false;
        }

        return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
    }

    return true;

```java
//@                      (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6)));

public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
    if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

    int len = digits.length;

    //@ maintaining 0 <= i < len / 2;
    //@ ensures (\forall int j; 0 <= j <= i; 
    //@                     ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
    //@                      (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
    //@                      (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
    //@                      (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
    //@                      (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6)));
```
    for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
        int a = digits[i];
        int b = digits[len - i - 1];

        if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
              (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
              (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
              (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
              (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    if ((len % 2) == 1) {
        int mid = digits[len / 2];
        return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```java
    }

    return true;
```
```java
}
```

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}
```

public class TitleCase {
```java
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
```

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}
```

```java
    public static void DivArrayByTwo(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null)
            return;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; ++i) {

        }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {

            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```java
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```java
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
    }

```java
    //@ requires b != null;
    //@ requires (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
```

```java
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;
```

    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    }
```

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;

```java
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;
```

```java
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {

        int m = a[0].length;
```

```java
    //@ requires a != null;
    //@ requires b != null;
    //@ requires a.length == b.length;
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] != null && b[i] != null && a[i].length == b[i].length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;

    //@ ensures \fresh(\result);
    //@ ensures \result.length == a.length;

    //@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < a.length && 0 <= j < a[i].length; \result[i][j] == a[i][j] + b[i][j]);
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; (\forall int j; 0 <= j < m; c[k][j] == a[k][j] + b[k][j]));
            //@ decreasing n - i;

        }

        return c;
    }
```

```java
public class MatrixSum {
    //@ requires a != null;
    //@ requires b != null;
    //@ requires a.length == b.length;
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] != null && b[i] != null && a[i].length == b[i].length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != a;
    //@ ensures \result != b;
    //@ ensures \fresh(\result);
    //@ ensures \result.length == a.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; \result[i].length == a[i].length);
    //@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < a.length && 0 <= j < a[i].length; \result[i][j] == a[i][j] + b[i][j]);
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; (\forall int j; 0 <= j < m; c[k][j] == a[k][j] + b[k][j]));
            //@ decreasing n - i;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
```

```java
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
```

```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {

            i = i + 1;
```

```java
    }
```

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

                return null;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}
```

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```java
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
```

```java
//@ maintaining \forall int k, l; 1 <= k < i && 1 <= l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1];
//@ behaviors complete;
//@ behaviors disjoint;
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining \forall int k, l; 1 <= k < i && 1 <= l < m; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1];
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ behaviors complete;
//@ behaviors disjoint;
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining \forall int k, l; 1 <= k < i && 1 <= l < m; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1];
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {

                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
//@ maintaining \forall int k, l; 1 <= k < i && 1 <= l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1];
//@ behaviors complete;
//@ behaviors disjoint;
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining \forall int k, l; 1 <= k < i && 1 <= l < m; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1];
```
```java
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ ensures (\exists int i, j; 1 <= i && i < mat.length && 1 <= j && j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) ==> \result == false;
```
```java
//@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k && k < i && 1 <= l && l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1);
//@ assigns \nothing;
//@ behaviors complete;
//@ behaviors disjoint;
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k && k < i && 1 <= l && l < m; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1);
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ assigns \nothing;

//@ behaviors disjoint;
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k && k < i && 1 <= l && l < m; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1);
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ ensures \result == false <==> (\exists int i, j; 1 <= i && i < mat.length && 1 <= j && j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]);
//@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k && k < i && 1 <= l && l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1);
//@ assigns \nothing;
//@ behaviors complete;
//@ behaviors disjoint;
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k && k < i && 1 <= l && l < m; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1);
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
```
                    return false;
```java
                }
            }
```
```java
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
```
        }

        return true;
```java
    }
}
```

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```java
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}
```

    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

    public static int sumSaturated(int a, int b) {
        long sum = (long)a + (long)b;
        if (sum > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        if (sum < Integer.MIN_VALUE)
            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        return (int)sum;
```java
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;

    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
```

```java
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
```

```java
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
```
```java
    }
```

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
```java
    }
}

```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
```
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
```java
                }
```
```java
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= index <= x.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int i; 0 <= i < index; x[i] == y[y.length - 1 - i];
        //@ loop_writes index;

        }
```

```java
    //@  requires txt != null;

    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
    public static void DivArrayByTwo(int[] arr) {
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;

    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;

        //@ loop_writes i;
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;

            ret[i] = a[i];
```

```java
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
        int right1  = rec1[2];

}
```

```java
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```
```java
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ behaviors disjoint;
```
```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
```
```java
        //@ requires mat != null;
        //@ requires mat.length > 0;
        //@ requires \forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length;
        //@ assigns \nothing;
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
```
```java
                //@ maintaining 1 <= i < n;
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j < m;
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        //@ requires mat != null;
        //@ requires mat.length > 0;
        //@ requires \forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length;
        //@ assigns \nothing;
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                //@ maintaining 1 <= i < n;
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j < m;

                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
//@ ensures \result == false;
//@ behaviors complete;
//@ behaviors disjoint;
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        //@ requires mat != null;
        //@ requires mat.length > 0;
        //@ requires \forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length;
        //@ assigns \nothing;
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

            //@ maintaining 1 <= i < n;
```
```java
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j < m;
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        //@ requires mat != null;
        //@ requires mat.length > 0;
        //@ requires \forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length;

        if (mat.length == 0) return true;

            //@ maintaining 1 <= i < n;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j < m;

                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
```
```java
        //@ requires mat != null && mat.length > 0 && (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length);

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        //@ requires mat != null && mat.length > 0 && (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length);

        }
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        //@ requires mat != null && mat.length > 0 && (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length);

        }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
```

```java
public class ReverseArray {
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];

}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ decreasing m-i;
```
```java
//@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < A.length && 0 <= j && j < A[0].length; \result[A.length-1-i][A[0].length-1-j] == A[i][j]);
```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;
```

```java
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    //@  requires arr != null;
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
```

```java
    //@ requires a != null;
```

```java
    //@ also
```
```java
    //@ requires a == null || a.length == 0 || \exists int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] == null || a[i].length != a.length;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;

                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```java
            return false;
```
```java
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
```

```java
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
```

```java
public class Swap1 {
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length ||
            b < 0) {
            return;
        }
        int temp = arr[a];
        arr[a] = arr[b];
        arr[b] = temp;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@ requires 0 <= a && a < arr.length;
    //@ requires 0 <= b && b < arr.length;
    //@ assigns arr[a], arr[b];
    //@ ensures arr[a] == \old(arr[b]) && arr[b] == \old(arr[a]);
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length || b < 0) {
            return;
        }
        int temp = arr[a];
        arr[a] = arr[b];
        arr[b] = temp;
```

```java
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;

    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ ensures \result == true;
```
```java
//@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]);
//@ assigns \nothing;
//@ behaviors complete;
//@ behaviors disjoint;
```

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
```java
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] != null);
    //@ ensures \result == true;
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 <= i < n;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j < m;
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ behaviors disjoint;

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] != null);
    //@ ensures \result == true;
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 <= i < n;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j < m;
                //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k < i && 1 <= l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1]);
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ requires mat != null;
//@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] != null);
//@ ensures \result == true;
//@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]);
//@ assigns \nothing;
//@ behaviors complete;
//@ behaviors disjoint;

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] != null);
    //@ ensures \result == true;
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 <= i < n;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j < m;
                //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k < i && 1 <= l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1]);
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
//@ behaviors complete;
//@ behaviors disjoint;

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] != null);
    //@ ensures \result == true;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 <= i < n;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j < m;
                //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k < i && 1 <= l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1]);
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < mat.length && 0 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] != null);
    //@ ensures \result == true;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 <= i < n;

                //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k < i && 1 <= l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1]);

                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < mat.length && 0 <= j && j < mat[i].length; mat[i][j] != null);
    //@ ensures \result == true;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i && i < mat.length && 1 <= j && j < mat[i].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == true;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i && i < mat.length && 1 <= j && j < mat[i].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]);
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 <= i && i < n;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                //@ maintaining 1 <= j && j < m;
                //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k && k < i && 1 <= l && l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1]);
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {

            return false;
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
```
